thread:
Kevin: quick bug: the Console observability guide's example for splitting cost by route fails when traces are unsampled. panel returns 500. anyone else see this?
Anya: yep. the example groups by span_id. when span_id is missing panels can error. simple fix is to use coalesce(span_id, "unsampled") in the PromQL and be defensive about route label name changes (route vs route_name).
Mike: can you paste suggested PromQL? i'll add it to the migration section.
Anya: use: `sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, "unknown"), coalesce(span_id, "unsampled"))`. also add a note to reconcile token timing units for quantized models: `coalesce(rate(token_duration_seconds[5m]), rate(token_duration_ms[5m]) / 1000)` to avoid NaNs.
Kevin: perfect. i'll open a small docs PR with the coalesce fix, unit note, and add short SDK snippets (node + python) showing metadata key `route_name`.
Mike: add a one-line curl regression test so the query doesn't 500: `curl -s -XPOST https://metrics-api.internal/query -d '{"query":"sum(cost_total) by (coalesce(route, route_name, \"unknown\"), coalesce(span_id, \"unsampled\"))"}' | jq`
